name: Silk

abilityDetails.Dodge: Gelen bir temel saldırıdan veya temaslı özel saldırıdan geriye kaçarak kaçınma; Çeviklik ustalığı bu pencereyi genişletir.
abilityDetails.Evade: Rakip saldırılarından otomatik olarak kaçmayı sağlar.
abilityDetails.Physical Vulnerability: Fiziksel Direnci azaltarak saldırı ve yeteneklerden gelen fiziksel hasarı artırır.
abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.
abilityDetails.Sunder: Kritik Direncini sıfıra indirir ve artmasını engeller.
abilityDetails.Slow: Düşmanın Durdurulamaz (Unstoppable) ve Kaçış (Evade) yeteneklerini iptal eder.

signatureAbility:
Crazy Stuff Happens, I Punch It
Striking the Opponent with a Heavy Attack or while their back is against the wall inflicts a Slow Debuff for 2 seconds, paused while Silk has a personal Fury Passive or while the Opponent remains against the wall.
While this Slow is active, during Silk's attacks the Opponent suffers -[10 - 150]% Regeneration Rate.
immunityDetails:
• Yırtılma debuff'ları süresini %90 azaltır ☣️⏰
• Buff Bağışıklığı (sadece isabet buff'ına bağışık) 🗡️🚫
• %30 Dejenerasyon direnci (ile sinerji: Spider-Gwen ve Miles) ☠️

abilitySections.title: Always Active
content: Silk's heightened agility keeps her one step ahead of danger. Incoming Ruptures and Slows suffer -90% duration.
While Dodging back, Silk cannot be struck by attacks. She does not benefit from the Dexterity Mastery, but each rank grants her +[200] Critical Rating.

abilitySections.title: Silk-Sense - Evade
content: Silk has a 100% chance to Evade Special Attacks.
After triggering or when Silk is Critically Hit, this effect goes on cooldown for 25 seconds or until the Opponent is struck 20 times.

abilitySections.title: All Attacks
content: Silk's attacks inflict a [305.56] Physical Vulnerability Debuff for 1.2 seconds. Max stacks: 50.
Silk's Physical Vulnerability Debuffs are refreshed when the Opponent is struck, and removed when the Opponent activates a Special Attack or is knocked down.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: While charging a Heavy Attack, if the Opponent is within striking distance and suffering from any of Silk's Physical Vulnerability Debuffs, inflict a Stun Debuff for 1.2 seconds.
The first hit grants Silk a Fury Passive increasing Attack Rating by +[7,391.4] for 1.2 seconds. Max stacks: 3.
Silk's Fury Passives are refreshed when the Opponent is struck, and removed when the Opponent activates a Special Attack or is knocked down.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: The final hit deals a burst of [14,782.8] Physical Damage.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: The first hit inflicts a Sunder Debuff for 30 seconds.
The final hit deals a burst of [24,638] Physical Damage.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Knocking down the Opponent with this Special Attack does not remove Silk's active personal effects.
Inflict a Stun Passive for 4 seconds. While this Stun is active, the Opponent suffers -100% Combat Power Rate and Silk's is increased by +100%.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Crazy Stuff Happens, I Punch It
content: Striking the Opponent with a Heavy Attack or while their back is against the wall inflicts a Slow Debuff for 2 seconds, paused while Silk has a personal Fury Passive or while the Opponent remains against the wall.
While this Slow is active, during Silk's attacks the Opponent suffers -[10 - 150]% Regeneration Rate.
